title: A finite-coefficient bound for constant adic cohomology at a geometric point
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and let $k$ be algebraically closed with $\operatorname{char}k\ne\ell$.
Let $s:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be an isomorphism and let $f:X\to Y$ be locally
of finite type, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Write $\nu_X^*$ for inverse image from
the small etale to the small pro-etale site. Suppose $b\ge0$ is an integer such that, for
every finite commutative ring $\Lambda$ and every etale sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules,
$Rf_*\nu_X^*F$ has no cohomology above $b$ (the finite-coefficient uniform bound of
[def-sf-uniform-direct-image-vanishing], transported to pro-etale sheaves of etale origin).
Then $Rf_*\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$, calculated in the category of modules over the
continuous constant adic coefficient sheaf, has no cohomology above $b$. Here the unit is
the underlying constant sheaf of [def-weil-constant-weil-structure], rather than an
arbitrary rational local system.

source.place: Proof, Steps 5-7, finite-level passage and rationalization, specialized to ordinary direct images of the constant sheaf; Milne LEC, Theorems 15.1 and 19.2

proof.text: Identify Y with Spec k using s. For each n use the etale constant integral coefficient sheaf modulo ell^n. Its pro-etale inverse image satisfies the assumed bound b.

The exact coefficient reduction sequence has kernel another finite-coefficient sheaf of etale origin. Its direct image in degree b+1 vanishes, so the maps on the degree b direct images are epimorphic. Locally on weakly contractible pro-etale objects, countable products are exact and the Mittag-Leffler surjectivity kills R^1 lim in degree b+1. All higher degrees vanish because each level vanishes above b. Thus the integral derived limit has the same bound.

Identify the actual integral continuous constant sheaf with the inverse limit of its torsion quotients on pro-etale objects. Direct image, a right adjoint, commutes with derived inverse limits; use this to identify the preceding derived limit with the integral constant-sheaf direct image.

Localize at ell and extend coefficients to finite extensions of Q_ell; flatness preserves the upper cohomological bound. The continuous Qbar_ell unit is the filtered coefficient extension of these units. On the qcqs bases used to compute direct image, cohomology commutes with this filtered extension. Its exactness preserves the uniform bound b.

A uniform upper cohomological bound for finite etale coefficient sheaves implies the same bound for the constant l-adic sheaf by derived inverse limit and flat scalar extension

theorem isLE_rightDerivedFunctor_adicLowerStar_unit_of_finite_bound
    {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsIso s] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hchar : ringChar k ≠ l) (b : ℕ)
    (hfinite : ∀ (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ],
      ∀ F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ),
        ((ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj F))).IsLE (b : ℤ)) :
    ((f)_*ᵃ[l].rightDerivedFunctor.obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (AdicSheaf.unit l X))).IsLE (b : ℤ)
